# CG-RES-016: Success response removed

A success (2XX) response key is absent from the candidate.

**Why it matters:** Consumers branch on success status codes.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Detects | `response.removed` |
| Severity | breaking: critical · potentially breaking: high · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Success response {status} of {operation} was removed{fallback}.
>
> Consumers expecting {status} will receive a different status or shape.
>
> **Fix:** Keep returning {status}, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: 200 replaced by 201

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
+       responses: {'201': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Success response 200 of GET /x was removed.

### Fires: 2XX removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {2XX: {description: ok}, '400': {description: bad}}
+       responses: {'400': {description: bad}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Success response 2XX of GET /x was removed.

### Does not fire: 200 → 2XX

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
+       responses: {2XX: {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
